registers.name: CR0
registers.note: Figure 2 (p.5): control register zero, written with D9-D8 (A1-A0) = 00; zeros after power up / hardware configuration (p.6)

registers.name: CR1
registers.note: Figure 2 (p.5): control register one, written with D9-D8 (A1-A0) = 01; D7, D5, D4 reserved (write 0, read back don't care)

commands.name: Write CR0
commands.note: Figure 2 (p.5): A(1:0) = D9-D8 = 00 selects CR0; latched on the WR rising edge (p.3); with CR0.D7 = 1 the WR rising edge also starts sampling (software start, Table 1 p.6)

ready.note: CR0.D6 = 0: INT, one pulse twL(INT) = 1 SYSCLK after each conversion (p.21; 111 ns at the 9-MHz minimum oscillator)
CR0.D6 = 1: EOC, high to low at the start of conversion, back high at its end (Table 1, p.6)

device.description: 10-bit 1.25 MSPS 8-channel parallel ADC with control registers, channel sweep, CSTART and INT/EOC
device.note: tlv1571.pdf (SLAS170D, TLV1571/TLV1578) p.1 pinouts, p.3 terminal functions, p.4-5 control registers (Figure 2), p.6 Table 1 conversion modes, p.7 programming examples, read back, power down, self tests, p.8-9 sampling/conversion and start of conversion, p.14 system clock source, output format, power up, p.18 recommended operating conditions, p.21 timing requirements

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (sampling frequency, register addressing), p.5 (Figure 2 control registers), p.6 (hardware configuration, Table 1 conversion modes), p.7 (Tables 2-4: programming, read back, power down, self tests), p.8 (sampling/conversion), p.9 (start of conversion), p.14 (system clock, output format, power up), p.18 (ROC), p.21 (timing requirements)
notModeled: analog input(s), references: every conversion returns the 0 V code (000h binary; 2s complement (CR1.D3 = 1) of the unipolar range puts REFM = 0 V at 200h, modeled as codeFormat offset)

self tests CR1.D1-D0 (Table 4, p.7: 000h/200h/3FFh): modeled as normal conversions returning the 0 V code; register read-back (CR1.D2 = 1) outputs CR0 (D1-D0 = 0) or CR1 (D1-D0 = 1) on D7-D0 with D9-D8 as 0 (not stated in the datasheet), reserved selections 2-3 output the result

start of conversion: hardware start (CR0.D7 = 0, CSTART rising) and software start (CR0.D7 = 1, WR rising edge, then each RD rising edge) are both always enabled: the CSTART pin, a CR0 write with D7 = 1 and every completed read start a conversion regardless of CR0.D7; a CR1 write in software start mode does not start one

conversion time: 6 SYSCLK sampling + 10 SYSCLK conversion = 16 SYSCLKs (p.8-9, p.21) at the internal oscillator minimum (9 MHz slow, CR1.D6 = 0: 1778 ns; 18 MHz fast: 889 ns); with the external CLK (CR0.D5 = 1) it depends on CLK and is modeled as 0; hardware start converts in 10 SYSCLKs after CSTART rising (not distinguished)
hardware configuration mode (WR tied low, dummy RD loads defaults) and CLK setup/hold windows: not modeled
software power down by CS high (Table 3, p.7), CR0.D4 SWPWDN, auto power down: no bus-visible effect
data bus timing at DVDD = 3 V, 50 pF (p.21): tAcc = ten(RDL_DAV) 40 ns, tDf = tdis(RDH_DAV) 10 ns
power up: INT/EOC initially high; two write cycles configure the device; the first conversion after power down is invalid (p.14)
external MUX loop (MO output to AIN, p.1): analog
channel sweep mode (CR0.D3 = 1, sequences per CR0.D2-D0, Figure 2): conversions use the CHSEL channel number; the sweep sequence is not modeled
variants: TLV1571 (1 channel, DW/PW 24-pin) and TLV1578 (8-channel MUX with MO output, DA 32-pin) share tlv1571.pdf.
